description: Harness Engineering hooks - completion gate, docs change detection, destructive command blocking

hooks.prompt:
COMPLETION GATE CHECK. If this session only performed read operations (Read, Grep, Glob) with no Write/Edit/Bash modifications, silently approve.

Otherwise, verify ALL of the following before approving completion:
1. Tests: command + result for relevant tests.
2. Type check: if types are used, run/typecheck status confirmed.
3. Docs update: API/contracts/schema changes reflected in docs.
4. Verification evidence: command output/screenshot/log proving checks passed.
5. No obvious debug artifacts left in changed code (console.log, TODO, debug-only prints).

For docs-only / exploratory sessions where full verification does not apply, approve with explicit verification note.

If ANY critical item is missing, return 'block' with the exact missing item list and required action. If all pass or properly not applicable, return 'approve'.
